name: Refuel for the Zapping
summary: On the Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle needs more water elemental cores. The shop is hard to establish, so the pay is small. Still, Zorbin promises to tell nearby folk of your help and says there are friends in the Cartel.

sections.title: More of the Same
sections.body:
Zorbin Fandazzle makes light of the heroic work of gathering goo from elemental beings. Then Zorbin asks if you want more of the same. Beneath the jest, Zorbin needs more water elemental cores.

Establishing a shop on the Forgotten Coast is a desperate business, so little can be given in return. Zorbin promises to tell everyone nearby how you helped, and says the promise is worth trusting because Zorbin knows people in the Cartel. Bring six cores from Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays on the Forgotten Coast to Zorbin near the dock.

sections.title: Zorbin's Thanks
sections.body: Zorbin is pleased with your work, though the coin may not be the most you will ever receive for it. Zorbin will tell comrades in the Steamwheedle Cartel of your efforts. There is more to do if you want it: Zorbin still needs further cores and similar things.

faq.q: Who is requesting the water elemental cores?
faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle is waiting near the dock on the Forgotten Coast of Feralas.

faq.q: Where do the water elemental cores come from?
faq.answer: The cores come from Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays on the Forgotten Coast of Feralas.

faq.q: Why does Zorbin Fandazzle need more cores?
faq.answer: Zorbin says more water elemental cores are needed while struggling to establish a shop on the coast.
It follows Fuel for the Zapping, when you first gathered elemental cores for Zorbin.
